senses.gloss: m. (derisive denominative of חִדְקָא I) descendant of a thorny race.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 101a:10">Erub. 101ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 556:2">Yalk. Mic. 556</cite> (with ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:4">Mic. VII, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00207"><he>חֶדֶק</he></cite>; our w. absent in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
